decisions.reason: A schlager compilation CD launched only in 2018 still has uncertain prospects, costs little to keep listed in a warehouse-backed catalog of 60,000 items, and fits the firm's push into broader genres, so the option is worth holding open.

The illustrated release series builds on the label's core skill in carefully produced editions, has had only one year on the market, and keeping it costs little, so it should be kept until its results reveal more about its value.
